newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche Telekom stable in grey trade.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche Telekom stable in grey trade.

text.p: Shares in Deutsche Telekom AG were quoted at between 32.50 and 33.30 marks each in "grey market" trading early on Monday, independent brokers said just before their official start to trading on the Frankfurt bourse.
Telekom shares had on Friday traded at around 33.50 in the grey market, which refers to the market provided by brokers prior to a formal offering and which is not subject to official controls.
Deutsche Telekom shares were on Sunday officially priced at 28.50 marks each.

"There is a lot of demand but volumes are very thin. We're seeing very little (grey market trade) at the moment, but it could really pick up," said a trader at the independent brokers Schnigge & Partner in Frankfurt.
The trader said that most of the interest was seen at around 33 marks ($21.92).
Grey market trade is often seen as a good indicator to the opening price of an issue.
Telekom shares are due to start trade at bourse open at 0930 GMT. The Frankfurt bourse is expecting to give a first official quotation of the share price around an hour later.
